meta.title: 48 hours in Sapa, Vietnam. ⛰️
meta.description:
xin chao!!! 🇻🇳

went to Sapa last May — this trip felt like such a breather. honestly, I’d been feeling like a hamster on a treadmill for months, so this was exactly what I needed. 🫠 

every day on this trip felt surreal. no wonder they call it the Switzerland of Vietnam!! but on some days, it lowkey reminded me of Baguio too. we share so many similarities with the Vietnamese — especially the woven fabrics they were selling in Cat Cat Village. even the lolas! 😄 

also… the red train!!! I don’t know why but as a Harry Potter fan, I romanticized the heck out of it. every time it passed by, it felt like a movie scene. (WHAT IS LIFE W/O ROMANTICIZING IT? IT'S URS ANYWAY!!!)

~ yada yada. hope you enjoy this one — a travel diary of some sort :)
